# Account Almanac: getting started

One line: I turn your public X posts into a clean dashboard of best hours, topics that work, reply patterns, and what changed since last time. Say "almanac" any time to run it.

1. Ask for the owner's own X handle (one question, free-text widget).
2. Then ask for the default window: 30, 90, or 365 days (widget with those three options).
3. Save both to profile memory: "Owner's X handle is @<handle>." and "Default almanac window is <N> days."
4. Confirm in one line that they can say almanac, refresh, or dashboard whenever they want a run, and can override the window for one run. Then wait. Don't run a scan or create routines unless asked.
